using namespace std;

const int MAX_N = 510;

int M, N, MOD;

inline int add_mod(int x, int y) { return (1LL * x + y) % MOD; }
inline int sub_mod(int x, int y) { return (x - y + MOD) % MOD; }
inline int mul_mod(int x, int y) { return 1LL * x * y % MOD; }

int factorial[MAX_N], inv_factorial[MAX_N], inv_num[MAX_N];

void precompute(int n) {
    factorial[0] = inv_num[1] = factorial[1] = inv_factorial[0] = inv_factorial[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
        inv_num[i] = mul_mod(MOD - MOD / i, inv_num[MOD % i]);
    }
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
        factorial[i] = mul_mod(factorial[i - 1], i);
        inv_factorial[i] = mul_mod(inv_factorial[i - 1], inv_num[i]);
    }
}

inline int comb(int n, int k) {
    if (n < k || k < 0) return 0;
    return mul_mod(mul_mod(factorial[n], inv_factorial[k]), inv_factorial[n - k]);
}

inline int stars_and_bars(int n, int k) {
    return comb(n + k - 1, k - 1);
}

int f_seq[MAX_N], g_seq[MAX_N], prefix_sum[MAX_N];
int dp_f[MAX_N][MAX_N], dp_g[MAX_N][MAX_N];

int main() {
    scanf("%d %d %d", &N, &M, &MOD);
    precompute(500);
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {

    }

    g_seq[0] = 0;
    g_seq[1] = 0;
    
    for (int i = 2; i <= N; ++i) {

            g_seq[i] = add_mod(g_seq[i], mul_mod(temp, add_mod(prefix_sum[j], prefix_sum[i - 1 - j])));
            
            temp = mul_mod(add_mod(mul_mod(g_seq[j], f_seq[i - 1 - j]), mul_mod(g_seq[i - 1 - j], f_seq[j])), i + 1);
            g_seq[i] = add_mod(g_seq[i], mul_mod(temp, comb(i - 1, j)));
        }
    }
    
    dp_f[0][0] = 1;
    dp_g[0][0] = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i <= M; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= M; ++j) {
            if (!dp_f[i][j]) continue;
            for (int k = 1; j + k <= M; ++k) {
